row_policy: Keep every original report; do not reapply the source cohort filter after injection
removal_encoding: Existing FeatureBuilder: missing vessel_type produces is_tanker=0; no new unknown feature or cache
interventions: Mask vessel_type only; keep all other report values and rows.
features: Only is_tanker can change; validate actual full snapshots at first/middle/last decisions per case/config
evaluation: Same April 8-21 follow-up: original cases, clocks and crossing references; not verified docking
mitigation: None added; existing model preprocessing unchanged

metrics.MAE: Equal approach weight; selection realizations pooled within each approach
metrics.MdAE: Pooled absolute-error median over decision/seed pairs

limits: Simulated class removal; requested fractions do not establish natural source fault rates.
legacy: Prior missing_vessel_class_attack/results describes row exclusions and is superseded for this attack
